answer: An autonomous multi-agent economy can achieve robust Sybil resistance by requiring cryptographic proof-of-stake anchored to scarce hardware tokens distributed at dawn. Each validating agent must stake a verified amount of base asset, such as digital copper, combined with a unique zero-knowledge signature derived from a secure enclave quill. To launch a Sybil attack, a malicious actor must exponentially scale their capital expenditure and hardware attestations, making the cost of forging millions of fake identities economically prohibitive.
